categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Xinyichang Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent manufacturing equipment for the semiconductor, LED and new display, capacitor, and lithium battery industries. Key product lines include semiconductor die bond machines, LED and new display die bond machines, capacitor aging test equipment, and lithium battery sheet cutting and winding integrated machines. The company also produces core components such as drivers, high-precision DDR motors, linear motors, voice coil motors, and integrated controllers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including direct-drive vector control, embedded floating-point real-time multi-path motion control, automatic tracking and correction, deep learning-based machine vision algorithms, composite copper foil-aluminum foil coating, and optical coating technologies. It has developed high-speed precision motion control, dual-arm synchronous operation, Mini/Micro LED wafer intelligent sorting, and mixing algorithms. The equipment integrates with MES systems for cloud connectivity, big data analytics, intelligent work order production, and remote control. Core components are self-developed and produced, enhancing precision, stability, and cost control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Xinyichang serves leading domestic and international companies in semiconductor packaging, LED and new display, capacitor aging testing, and lithium battery manufacturing sectors. Notable customers include Huawei, Changdian Technology, Huatian Technology, Tongfu Microelectronics, Samsung Electronics, BOE, Sanan Optoelectronics, and others. The company targets industries such as automotive electronics, communications, memory, MEMS, analog and mixed-signal devices, power semiconductors, and new energy storage batteries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing bases in Shenzhen and Zhongshan. It maintains a global market orientation, supplying customers worldwide. Domestic sales dominate revenue, with a smaller portion from overseas markets. The company is expanding its overseas market presence and aims to enhance its global influence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xinyichang operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design and manufacture of intelligent manufacturing equipment used by downstream semiconductor, LED, capacitor, and lithium battery manufacturers. It also produces some core components in-house, positioning itself as a key equipment supplier enabling production automation and precision manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent manufacturing equipment for semiconductor packaging, Mini/Micro LED, capacitor aging testing, and lithium battery production. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 10% of revenue allocated to research activities. Current R&D projects include high-precision semiconductor wire bonding equipment, LED micro-device packaging, semiconductor testing and sorting machines, and high-power servo motors. The company emphasizes core technology development, integration with digital manufacturing systems, and domestic substitution of imported equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of intelligent manufacturing equipment and related parts and maintenance services. The company mainly uses a direct sales model with some agency sales for overseas markets. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery, customer acceptance, and receipt of payment. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xinyichang is a leading domestic player in intelligent manufacturing equipment for semiconductor packaging, new display, and capacitor aging testing, with a strong brand and extensive customer base. It competes against international giants from the Netherlands, Japan, the USA, and Taiwan. The company maintains competitive advantages through core technology self-development, high product quality, and stable customer relationships, aiming to become a top-tier global intelligent manufacturing solutions provider.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 933.87 million, a 10.22% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 40.46 million, down 32.91%. Despite short-term pressure due to strategic transformation and contraction of traditional LED business, the company’s core business remains stable. Total assets reached RMB 2.83 billion, with R&D investment accounting for 10.45% of revenue. The company has a workforce of about 1,479 employees, including 335 R&D personnel.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xinyichang emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary core component manufacturing, and integration of intelligent manufacturing technologies to deliver high-precision, stable, and cost-effective equipment. Its products support domestic substitution of imported equipment in strategic industries, offering customized solutions and advanced automation features. The company’s close collaboration with leading customers and continuous innovation enable it to maintain a competitive edge and provide high value-added intelligent manufacturing solutions globally.
